methodology.responseTime: successful task API-side responseMs values from the export; failures are reported separately
methodology.confidenceIntervals: percentile bootstrap over independent run/repetition means; no interval is emitted for fewer than two repetitions
methodology.pairedComparison: matched trace task mean response differences, summarized at the repetition level
methodology.signTest: exact two-sided sign test over nonzero repetition-level paired mean differences; SciPy Wilcoxon signed-rank test is also applied to repetition means, with Holm correction across baseline contrasts
methodology.outliers: Tukey 1.5-IQR response-time flags are counted and retained; no values are removed
methodology.predictionError: uses the exported modelled actual component total (network + worker queue + worker execution) minus predicted total; API response time is separate
methodology.networkLimit: configured simulated RTT on single-host containers is not geographic network evidence
methodology.interpretation: descriptive and comparative output only; no performance benefit or statistical significance is assumed
